description: Sync Swell orders, customers, products and more to Airtable
name: Airtable

images.title: Tables set up in one click
images.description: Add your Airtable token and base, then run Create tables & columns from the Actions menu to create every table and column.

images.title: Backfill your history
images.description: Send existing records to Airtable one collection at a time, or every synced collection in one click.

images.title: Edit in Airtable, update Swell
images.description: Turn on Get updates from Airtable and pick the tables; edits to names, prices and stock reach Swell within about 5 minutes.

images.title: Every edit, accounted for
images.description: Each check that finds Airtable edits is logged with the records updated in Swell and the edits rejected.
